description: Multi-step System One showcase (XTRM-512): beam routing over the repository tree vs deterministic baselines, graded by git.
hypothesis: A System One beam over the tree, given only the task text, ranks the changed files above deterministic baselines at a cost of cents per hundred tasks.

legend.code-locator-hot-files: Deterministic: files ranked by how often they were modified before the base commit.
legend.code-locator-jev-beam: System One beam routing: one Jev request per step carrying one Choice per beam node (width 3); code keeps the best directories by geometric-mean path probability over answered steps; files become ranked leaves.
legend.code-locator-lexical: Deterministic: idf-weighted overlap of task words and path words over every file at the base commit.
